# Zapwebp

> Convert correctly. A universal image conversion engine that preserves transparency, strips metadata, and runs everywhere (browser, terminal, build tools, CI, AI agents). Open source, MIT licensed.

## Core

- [Home](https://zapwebp.vercel.app/): Landing page.
- [Docs](https://zapwebp-docs.vercel.app/docs): Full documentation.
- [CLI](https://zapwebp-docs.vercel.app/cli): Terminal tool.
- [MCP](https://zapwebp-docs.vercel.app/mcp): AI agent integration.
- [API](https://zapwebp-docs.vercel.app/api): REST API reference.

## SDKs

- [Core SDK](https://zapwebp-docs.vercel.app/sdk/core): @zapwebp/core — the engine.
- [Plugin SDK](https://zapwebp-docs.vercel.app/sdk/plugin): @zapwebp/plugin-sdk — build plugins.
- [UI SDK](https://zapwebp-docs.vercel.app/sdk/ui): @zapwebp/ui — error and upload components.
- [CLI SDK](https://zapwebp-docs.vercel.app/sdk/cli): CLI flags and options.
- [Storage SDK](https://zapwebp-docs.vercel.app/sdk/storage): @zapwebp/storage — cloud upload wrapper.
- [Edge SDK](https://zapwebp-docs.vercel.app/sdk/edge): @zapwebp/edge — edge runtime.

## Error codes

- [Errors](https://zapwebp-docs.vercel.app/errors): Every E_* code, cause, and fix.

## Plugins

- [Vite](https://zapwebp-docs.vercel.app/plugins/vite): Vite build plugin.
- [Next.js](https://zapwebp-docs.vercel.app/plugins/next): Next.js build plugin.
- [GitHub Action](https://zapwebp-docs.vercel.app/plugins/github-action): PR image optimization action.
- [Storage](https://zapwebp-docs.vercel.app/plugins/storage): Cloud storage upload interceptor.
- [VS Code](https://zapwebp-docs.vercel.app/plugins/vscode): VS Code / Open VSX extension.
- [Laravel](https://zapwebp-docs.vercel.app/plugins/laravel): Laravel service provider.
- [Lens](https://zapwebp-docs.vercel.app/plugins/lens): Image inspection and visual diffing.
- [Crop](https://zapwebp-docs.vercel.app/plugins/crop): Pure transform crop plugin with auto/manual modes and face detection.

- [Contributing](https://zapwebp-docs.vercel.app/contributing): Developer workflows and PR checklist.
- [Code of Conduct](https://zapwebp-docs.vercel.app/code-of-conduct): Community standards and pledge.
- [Security](https://zapwebp-docs.vercel.app/security): Security policy and vulnerability disclosure.
- [Translators](https://zapwebp-docs.vercel.app/translators): Translation guide and recognized contributors.

- [Discussions](https://github.com/Zapwebp/discussions): Developer discussions and Q&A.
